questions.prompt: Q has shape (2, 5, 8) and K has shape (2, 7, 8). What shape are the attention scores?
questions.explanation: Q @ K.swapaxes(-1, -2) is (2, 5, 8) @ (2, 8, 7) = (2, 5, 7): one score per (query, key) pair in each batch.

questions.prompt: What happens if you forget to divide the scores by √d_k when d_k is large?
options: Softmax saturates towards one-hot and gradients vanish
questions.explanation: Dot products have variance about d_k, so large scores push softmax towards one-hot, where its gradients are close to zero.

questions.prompt: With a causal mask, query position 2 may attend to which key positions?
questions.explanation: Causal attention allows j ≤ i: the token itself and everything before it, which is the lower triangle including the diagonal.
